บ้านไม้ยกพื้น (Thai wooden stilt house): A rural single-storey wooden house raised on posts, seen frontally at eye level in daylight; hazy pale sky. The roof is grey corrugated metal with a shallow slope. The upper floor has brown wooden walls and an open veranda with a white-painted wooden balustrade; many colourful clothes hang on a line along the veranda, and a striped red-and-green blanket and other cloths are draped over the railing. One wooden staircase with a white handrail runs diagonally down from the centre of the veranda to the right, roughly 10-12 steps (exact count unclear). Under the house: a wooden cart, stored items, piled wood at left. Potted plants sit at the foot of the stairs. The ground is bare, dry, light-brown dirt. Large leafy tropical plants frame the left and right edges; dense bamboo and trees fill the background.
